name: microhouse premium export profile (issue #117)
note: Gates the premium/export chain (#28) — the path #111 shipped through while the ratchet only rendered the real-time mix. Bounds are anchored to the mastering targets (MasteringTargets::hypothesis(): −8.5 LUFS ± 0.5 integrated, −1.0 dBTP ceiling) and genre knowledge, not to any render: the true-peak and sample-peak maxima are the ceiling guarantee (#112), the rms minimum is the loudness target (#111 — the double-mastered export landed ~9 LU under), and the crest window keeps the gate honest in both directions (the unmastered mix sits at ~22 dB crest, an over-limited one collapses below 6). The healthy post-#115 export sits inside every bound, so the baseline distance is 0.0 and the ratchet exists to absorb cross-host float drift (libm/LLVM decorrelates the acid resonator; see golden.rs provenance), not to license misses — re-anchor only with a documented, deliberate sound change, as with the real-time baseline.
